theorem negativeCurvatureInequality
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (x y z : X.Point) :
    dist z (X.affineCombination t x y) ^ 2 ≤
      t * dist z x ^ 2 + (1 - t) * dist z y ^ 2 -
        t * (1 - t) * dist x y ^ 2 := by
  sorry
